headline: Bernanke on *no-doc* mortgage loans
quote: 60% of non-prime loans had little or no documentation
title: Fed Chair Bernanke: Mortgage standards collapsed leading into 2008
caption: Ben Bernanke detailed the severe decline in underwriting standards prior to the 2008 financial crisis. He noted that by 2007, 60% of non-prime mortgages were issued with little to no financial documentation.
comment: Were lax lending standards the primary cause of the 2008 housing crash?
